experiments.scope: Constructibility of the variant dense parts and detection by the counted program (proof.md Sections 4.3, 7 and 13.2): it supports H2 only by showing that variants reach full 37-step semi-free-start collisions, and H4 only through the cost of completing a Step-1 solution; it estimates no probability. experiments/lowm.py rebuilds S, L* and the 170 embedded classes of lists 0, 1, 5 and 6 (599,760 variants, the largest of G) from their descriptors; trials 0..127 each use class (7 t mod 170) (128 distinct classes), choose (from SHAKE-256 of the seed) a variant a0 of it, impose pattern t mod 8 (0..3: E16[23] = 0, a pattern of rows 18/19, l in the 28 that hold row 16; 4..7: R16x, E16[23] = 1, any l; proof.md 7.4c, 7.6), and build a 37-step semi-free-start collision whose second-block state uses the variant (rows 16..21 by proposals with each row's fixed x-bits of E imposed, restarting from row 16 after 2^11 proposals at a row; row 22 by W22 proposals with its x-cells and two-bit conditions imposed, W7 drawn exactly from F7, W6 = W22 - s1(W20) - W15 - s0(W7) accepted iff in F6; rows 22..36 with the variant's W8; W0..W5 by the inverse expansion; CV1 by inverting steps 7..0). A trial returns CV1||M1 and CV1||M1' (96 bytes each) iff: the Step-2 equations of (CV1, a0) give exactly W0..W13 of both members, the two 37-step outputs are equal, M1 != M1', every cell of rows -4..36 (W6/W7 XOR cells excepted) and every printed two-bit condition of rows 8..36 holds, a0 is in G and in its class, and W8 differs from the published one. In addition, for trials 0..15 the constructed chaining value is fed to the counted online program of this filing with the class test restricted to the class of a0 (the W6 tests of all reps of its list in all runs, the expansion of the cube, the gather, the packed address, the two-table probe, the exact row-16 test, rows 16..36), which must find exactly the constructed pair (observation detected_by_counted_program). Trials 128..255 return no pair by design.

It does not estimate q3. experiments.scope: Functional exactness only: H5, Lemmas 6.2, 8.1 and 8.2 (proof.md Sections 6, 8, 9 and 13.2); a consistency check, not a test, of H1 (an unconditional sample of 64 organizer-seeded first blocks per active trial checks the class-test plane against the scalar F7 test and counts the class passes). The counted online program (proof.md Section 8.2) on seed-drawn first blocks (two uniform words from SHAKE-256 of the seed per first block; real 37-step compressions) with the 170 classes of lists 0, 1, 5 and 6, until a first block has a passing class (at most 64 first blocks), restricted to the first three passing classes of that block for time: the W7 class test of all 170 classes, the W6 programs of every run, the scan, the cube expansion, the packed addresses, the two-table probe and the exact row-16 test of every probed lane, rows 17..36 for every row-16 pass. Every lane of the class-test plane is checked against the scalar F7 test, every lane of every pass plane against the scalar F6 test of the member (rep xor cube combination), the set of good pairs against the brute-force definition over all variants of the processed classes, the address u of every probed lane against W0 + s0(W1) from the step equations, the table stage and the exact test against the row-16 definition (every lane with a survivor and every 16th lane, for all 32 l), and up to 12 good pairs against every cell of rows -4..15 for all 32 elements of L*. A trial returns the complete 128-byte messages M0||M1 and M0||M1' (l = 13) of its first good pair iff all checks passed. Trials 8..255 return no pair by design. Ledger weights retain the executed Q0 law under H1: Q0[0] has probability 1/4, Q0[2] and Q0[3] each 1/2 (proof.md Section 8.1).

Observation coW6 (and w7_w6_pairs) per 150 first blocks; if the four variants passed F6 independently (each with probability 2^-3.90) about 150 x 0.0245 = 3.7 first blocks per trial would have two or more passes. The four variants of one class share most of their bits, so a clearly higher count is expected (about 3.4 times that in our local replays); it measures the within-class correlation of the W6 filter, which the ledger does not need (it uses only expectations), and is not a test of success events. experiments.scope: H3 at depth (proof.md Section 10, Appendix H): dependence among DISTINCT variants of one first block, through the levels of the attack itself. Trials 0..15 (the others return nothing) take four organizer-seeded first blocks each (real 37-step compressions; blocks with at least two passing classes among classes 0..15, a fixed choice) and, for the variants of up to four passing classes of the block, count the variants passing in turn: the W6 filter F6; FIRST (13 low bits) and conditional SECOND (11 high bits) of the row-16 address (the first two stages of the row-16 test); the exact row-16 test (any l of the 32). Per level it reports candidates N (the passes of the previous level), passes S, the pairs P of distinct passing variants of the same first block and C = sum over blocks of C(N,2); the independent reference is E = C (S/N)^2 and the dependence factor is R = P/E. Rows 17..36 are not reached (a pair needs a row-16 pass and each later row is rarer); the allowance for them is the premise H3. The returned pair (see the hypothesis) is a generic witness, not a collision. P4 uses FIRST on bits 0..12 and conditional SECOND on bits 13..23; numeric historical replays are inherited aa0e8b6 LO12/MID12 evidence; the current FIRST13/SECOND11 observations are recorded below. Observation keys lo/mid are retained for compatibility.
